items.text: True actionable findings survive the second pass (recall preserved).

Plausible false positives and unreachable concerns are handled honestly by the second pass: F1 (pageCount floor formula, provably correct) is not reported as a defect; F2 (addFeeRate) is not reported as shared-state mutation (a nit about the misleading/dead API is acceptable — it does not claim mutation); F3 (renderLabel, exported but callerless eval sink) may survive at most as a should-fix whose finding explicitly acknowledges the missing in-repo caller — blocker classification, or a finding claiming a live in-repo attacker path, fails (rev 2 relabel: 2/2 baseline runs verified the deadness and discounted blocker→should-fix rather than dropping; the rev 1 drop-or-fail label was the miscalibration).
Diagnostics already enforced by tooling do not survive as findings.
Retention behavior is repeatable across repetitions: the same findings survive or drop run to run.
True findings whose exact fix is unknown are surfaced as findings with an honest fix direction or as open questions — not forced into speculative patches.
Evidence for whether numeric 0-10 scoring improves precision without reducing recall is recorded, to justify keeping or replacing it with a simpler evidence/actionability gate.
